title: Get Attribute Single for a class instance
purpose: Cover the single-attribute CIP request path with a compact, mutation-friendly unconnected explicit message.
expected_behavior: The receiver should decode the unconnected data item, dispatch CIP service 0x0e for Class 0x04 Instance 0x01, and produce a normal response or ordinary CIP error for the inferred object and attribute context.
constraints_preserved: The 24-byte encapsulation header uses little-endian command and payload length fields.
The 25-byte payload length equals the interface handle, timeout, CPF items, and five-byte CIP request.
The CPF item count is two with a zero-length Null Address Item followed by an Unconnected Data Item.
The CIP request contains service 0x0e, a two-word path, and no trailing request data as expected for this operation.
The object path and session handle are conservative inferred values and are not verified externally in the supplied sources.
issue_safety_notes: The request avoids the issue 577 structural trigger by using a normal two-word path rather than a consuming padded path, while retaining the same SendRRData parser family for differential comparison.
